reason: I have a big duvet and no laundry area in my small apartment, so a one-off wash and dry for R$ 42 is a real solution. The Bistek next door means I can do the groceries while it runs. I would only try it once at first.
objection: Going out just to wash is a hassle, and I do not know anyone who has used it or seen Google reviews yet. I would worry the machine does not clean the duvet well or that it comes out damp.
would_change_my_mind: A friend recommending it, or good Google reviews showing duvets coming out clean and fully dry.
